item.title: npm 12 Released: Install Scripts Off by Default as Registry Moves to Explicit Trust
item.description: npm 12 introduces significant security-related changes, making certain installation behaviors opt-in. Notably, script allowances are now off by default, which requires explicit approval for running scripts, including implicit builds. (1 source: infoq)
